The '''Mission to Q'Maere''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Q'Maere]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' discovered a [[Q'Maere Research Facility|research facility]] on the planet allied to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] that held political and New Republic prisoners.
